items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: That was my man. Yes. Paul Detroit, because I used to like to hear, I'd get him at the theater in time to hear him come out and tune up his drums, you know.

ctx.x: Well I mean I suppose when you named those two, those are your major influences, but everybody can hear something in somebody else which is interesting.

That was my man. Yes. Paul Detroit, because I used to like to hear, I'd get him at the theater in time to hear him come out and tune up his drums, you know. He used to sound so good. That big bass drum used to sound so good.
Well Zutty, of course they were like inspirations or influences, whatever you call them. But I mean your own thing was not like theirs.
